name: Dirtbag
overview:
Where it all started. The Dirtbag legacy web series is where the chaotic characters of David Dirtbag, Cameron Mann (... and Clown) were born!

Former wannabe TV naturalist David Dirtbag (real name: David Charles) forces himself to illegally move in with his former cameraman, Cameron Mann. The CCB continue to make Cameron's work life hell, and if Larry the landlord finds out about David, his personal life will become even worse. Oh, and there's a clown that lives in the attic cupboard...
